# BigQuery geography function documentation: ST_LINELOCATEPOINT.

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 0)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 1)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ROUND(ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(2 2)')), 12)
=> "0.250152146851"

SELECT ROUND(ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(3 3)')), 12)
=> "0.500228428364"

SELECT ROUND(ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(4 4)')), 12)
=> "0.750190591388"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(5 5)'))
=> "1.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(6 5)'))
=> "1.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> null

# BigQuery observations.

# Boundary behavior and exact errors for ST_LINELOCATEPOINT.

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(11, 5))
=> "0.5000252592804417"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(170 10, -170 10)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 20))
=> "0.4999999999999995"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(-10, 1))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(20, 1))
=> "1.0"

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument was the empty geography. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument contained a point. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 0), (2 0, 3 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument had 2 lines. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument contained a polygon. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single point geography; an argument was the empty geography. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single point geography; an argument had 2 points. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single point geography; an argument contained a polygon. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: Argument to STLineLocatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument was the empty geography. Error in ST_LINELOCATEPOINT expression
